description: Visual regression check: screenshot a page and compare it with another URL (preview against production) or with an earlier screenshot. Returns the share of changed pixels, a same/different verdict, boxes around the changes and a diff image. Price: $0.04 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Web tools: A real browser for agents: screenshot any page on desktop or phone, read a page as clean Markdown, print a URL or HTML to PDF, draw HTML to an image, make social cards, audit a page for SEO, speed, accessibility and broken links, and compare two versions of a page pixel by pixel..

baselineImage.description: Or an earlier screenshot as base64 PNG, taken with the same device and settings.

baselineUrl.description: Page to compare against: production against a preview deploy, for example.

device.description: desktop 1280x800, laptop 1440x900, tablet 810x1080, phone 390x844 with a mobile browser identity.

failPercent.description: Above this share of changed pixels the pages count as different.

hide.description: CSS selectors to hide in both: timestamps, carousels, ads, anything that changes on its own.

url.description: The page to check (the new version).

waitFor.description: CSS selector that must be visible before the capture.

waitMs.description: Extra wait after the page has loaded, for animations or late content.

name: web_tools_visual_diff
